Subject: Next steps: 30-minute product preview and stakeholder slots (BlueLattice)

Hi Amy (and Tom),

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn how BlueLattice is approaching noisy-transaction classification and the constraints you're seeing around inference latency and per-transaction cost. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: near-real-time scoring of incoming transactions (~50–200 reqs/sec) with bursts up to 800/sec.
- Success criteria: median latency < 120 ms p50, cost per 1k requests under target once batched, and auditability for regulatory logs.
- Key risks: integration with existing message bus, data residency, and SOC2 evidence for inference access logs.

Next step: we'd like to run a short 30-minute product preview for the broader stakeholder group and tech owners to walk through architecture fit and a quick demo of a representative flow. Proposed slots (all PT):

1) Tue, 15 Dec — 14:00–14:30 PT
2) Wed, 16 Dec — 09:00–09:30 PT
3) Thu, 17 Dec — 10:00–10:30 PT

Please pick the best single slot or tell us two alternatives that work for you and your tech lead. If none of these fit, propose a couple of windows and we’ll coordinate.

What we'll bring: a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps ownership and a one-page 30-minute agenda (attached). For the preview, we recommend the following attendees: product sponsor, tech owner, and one person from ops/security. If Tom will join, please let us know whether he wants the session to include a short security/infra segment so we can allocate time.

I'll have Priyom lock the calendar once you confirm.

Thanks,
Sofia

--
